verdict.rationale: Entrust IDV's own API docs describe configuring webhook events that asynchronously notify you of workflow status changes. Payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using a per-webhook secret token, and webhooks are a documented way to retrieve results programmatically. Missing for 10: a documented event-type catalog and retry/delivery semantics, explicit registration API details, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: asynchronously monitor the status of identity verification workflows by configuring webhook events to notify you of changes in workflow status
You can get the expected signature of the webhook by computing the HMAC of the event request body using the SHA256 algorithm, using the webhook's secret token as the key.
